correctness.rationale: Integer Q^7=I+2B and Q^14=I+4D with B,D unimodular. Q mod2 acts on the seven nonzero primitive parity triples. All seven (output parity,b-leading,d-leading) types computed exactly. Two b=d=1 branches cover opposite parity targets once; two b=0,d=1 branches have 0-or-2 fibers; three d=0 branches admit fixed-point-free index translation pairing for k>=3. Boundary k=1,2 separately established. Executed checker confirms matrices, leading terms and exhaustive primitive fibers through k=5; infinity follows from proof.
